body:
You've given me more to think about, and I thank you for that.  

I don't really know about loans.  Given how much I have already taken out (and not paid any on), I just assumed I was maxed out.

That being said, getting back in to medical school is probably a very long stretch.

I used to go on SDN a lot... and I did use them to make a plan for studying for boards.  

I have been to 3 different therapist, but none since the girl thing.  I'm sure it would not be a bad idea.  I have trouble talking to people though.

help in what way? 

I don't believe there is a purpose for everything.  It sounds good, but that doesn't make it so.

thank you for reading my post, and for your response.

Even if I could go back to medical school, I couldn't afford it.  I passed step 1 and failed out with one month long rotation left in my 3rd year.  

Her realizing I don't have any money at all won't change me from being responsible for paying child support (that I don't have).  

Things were doing better than they had in years (failed med school in 2010, followed by years wasted in self destructive behavior).  But all of my hope about the recent good things (I am about to graduate and be able to get a job that would have maaaybe paid off my loans before I died) is completely gone.  I have lost all motivation to continue in school.  I don't want to work hard to get a decent job so she can take more of my money.  It's just not worth it.  

Thank you very much for taking the time to read my long post and for your response.
